entries.name: audit-evidence-reliability
entries.description: Guide factory-side construction of audit evidence scenarios when a professional must assess the accuracy, completeness, or reliability of company-produced information or conflicting audit records. Do not use for generic spreadsheet reconciliation or routine formatting.

entries.name: procurement-price-reasonableness
entries.description: Guide factory-side construction of simplified-acquisition scenarios where a professional assesses price reasonableness from quotations, market support, estimates, and award-file documentation. Do not use for generic vendor comparison or routine spreadsheet formatting.
